name: MMDemo Namespace Contract
purpose: isolate all synthetic/demo-created data used by the /mmdemo browser from canonical AIGMos semantic identities and production data
appliesTo: demo projects/orders/messages/files/measurements and other generated instance data
rules: synthetic data created specifically for /mmdemo MUST use the mmdemo. prefix
canonical definitions referenced by the demo retain their canonical identities
mmdemo data MUST NOT become canonical source evidence
mmdemo data MUST NOT be returned by production projections unless an explicit demo context requests it
deleting all mmdemo.* data MUST NOT damage canonical definitions
demo fixtures may be regenerated without changing canonical semantic identity
authorization and validation rules still apply to demo execution paths
unresolved Strategy/Everyday/BusinessSuite display names MUST NOT be encoded as guessed canonical IDs in demo fixtures
